svg.aria-label: A popped batch moves from the inbox to in flight under a lease of 20 s for a hook or 60 s for the watcher. An acknowledgement ends it. An expired lease returns the batch to the inbox, up to 3 times, and the next expiry moves it to the dead-letter list.
